About RENPHO
At RENPHO, we believe technology should make wellness, beauty, and self-care more accessible, intuitive, and part of everyday life.
Founded in 2016, RENPHO has grown into a global consumer technology brand serving more than 20 million users worldwide. Our portfolio spans smart wellness devices, beauty technology, and recovery solutions designed to help people better understand, care for, and improve their well-being.

As we continue to grow, we're focused on building a stronger brand presence, creating meaningful connections with consumers, and becoming part of the conversations shaping modern wellness and beauty.

About the Role

We're looking for a passionate, well-connected, and culturally curious Influencer & Creator Partnerships Manager to build and grow RENPHO's creator ecosystem in the United States.
This is a relationship-driven role focused primarily on organic influencer engagement, creator discovery, product seeding, and long-term partnerships.

We're looking for someone who genuinely understands the creator landscape, knows how to identify influential voices across different communities, and has the ability to turn authentic relationships into compelling content, meaningful engagement, and brand growth.
You should be equally comfortable connecting with established creators and discovering emerging talent before everyone else does.

Rather than focusing on transactional influencer recruitment, you'll help build a community of creators who genuinely connect with RENPHO's products and want to share their experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong industry relationships, cultural awareness, creative instincts, and an analytical understanding of social media performance.

Influencer Discovery & Relationship Building
Build and maintain a strong network of US-based influencers, content creators, and emerging social media talent.
Establish authentic, long-term relationships with creators through personalized outreach, product experiences, and ongoing engagement.
Develop and manage a curated roster of creators who align with RENPHO's brand values, product categories, and target audiences.
Identify high-potential creators capable of generating exceptional organic reach, engagement, and brand visibility.
Develop relationships that extend beyond individual campaigns, encouraging ongoing product discovery, advocacy, and content collaboration.
Build and maintain a structured creator database, tracking relationships, product interests, collaboration history, and performance.

Creator Audience Development & Community Intelligence
Map and develop creator communities across relevant consumer audiences, including:
Beauty, skincare, and beauty technology

Men's wellness and grooming
Women's wellness and lifestyle

Technology, gadgets, and product discovery
Identify influential voices, emerging trends, and underserved creator communities.
Evaluate creators based on audience relevance, content quality, engagement, authenticity, and growth potential.
Maintain an active understanding of the US influencer landscape across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Recommend new creator audiences and partnership opportunities based on product launches, seasonal priorities, and consumer trends.

Organic Influencer Activation & Product Seeding
Develop and execute a scalable, product-led influencer engagement program.
Match RENPHO products with creators whose interests, lifestyles, and content naturally align with the product experience.

Engagement rates and audience interaction

Creator relationship development and retention

success.

Coordinate with Creative and Social Media teams to maximize the visibility of high-performing creator content.
Identify opportunities to integrate creators into brand campaigns, events, experiential marketing, and product storytelling.

Required
3–5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media, or talent relations, preferably within a US consumer brand.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role is measured by the quality and impact of the creator relationships you build—not simply the number of influencers contacted or products distributed.

You'll help RENPHO:
Establish a strong, growing network of engaged creators across priority consumer audiences.

Who Will Thrive Here
You're naturally curious about people, culture, and social media.

About RENPHO

RENPHO is a global consumer wellness technology brand dedicated to making healthier living more accessible through innovative, thoughtfully designed products. Our portfolio spans smart health monitoring, fitness, recovery, massage, and personal wellness solutions, combining technology, functionality, and user-centered design to enhance everyday life.

As we continue to expand our global presence, we are looking for entrepreneurial product innovators who can identify emerging consumer needs, challenge conventional product thinking, and help shape the future of wellness technology.

About the Role

RENPHO is seeking an innovative, commercially minded Product Manager – Wellness & Health Tech to drive new product opportunities and concept development across our global wellness technology portfolio.

This role is designed for a product professional who thrives at the intersection of consumer insights, emerging technologies, product design, and commercial strategy.

You will be responsible for identifying untapped market opportunities, developing differentiated product concepts, evaluating technical and commercial feasibility, and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product development roadmaps.

Unlike traditional product management roles focused primarily on existing product maintenance or execution, this position emphasizes front-end innovation, global market exploration, and new product creation.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious, entrepreneurial, and passionate about bringing meaningful consumer technology innovations to market.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Global Market Research & Opportunity Identification

Conduct comprehensive market research across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other strategic international markets.

Identify emerging wellness trends, unmet consumer needs, competitive gaps, and untapped product categories.

Analyze consumer behavior, lifestyle changes, technology advancements, and category growth opportunities.

Monitor competitors, emerging brands, startups, and technology innovations to identify potential market disruptions.

Develop market opportunity assessments and recommend new product directions supported by consumer insights and commercial potential.

2. New Product Concept Development & Innovation

Lead early-stage product ideation, translating market opportunities into innovative, differentiated consumer product concepts.

Define product positioning, target consumers, key features, functional requirements, and unique value propositions.

Develop preliminary Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), concept briefs, and product specifications.

Explore opportunities to integrate emerging technologies, smart connectivity, sensors, and wellness-related innovations into consumer products.

Build and maintain a forward-looking product concept pipeline aligned with RENPHO’s global growth strategy.

3. Product Feasibility & Concept Validation

Collaborate closely with R&D, engineering, industrial design, and manufacturing teams to evaluate product feasibility.

Assess technical capabilities, production considerations, estimated development costs, and potential commercial viability.

Coordinate proof-of-concept development, rapid prototyping, and early-stage product testing.

Conduct competitive benchmarking, consumer feedback studies, and preliminary product-market fit evaluations.

Support structured Stage-Gate decision-making to determine which concepts should advance into formal product development.

4. Global Product Strategy & Roadmap Planning

Develop product proposals and innovation roadmaps based on global market demand, consumer insights, and business priorities.

Evaluate product opportunities using market size, competitive differentiation, target pricing, expected margins, and potential revenue.

Collaborate with commercial, marketing, and regional teams to ensure proposed products align with brand positioning and market needs.

Present product concepts, business cases, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Prioritize innovation initiatives based on strategic value, feasibility, and commercial potential.

5. Cross-Functional & International Collaboration

Work closely with product development, industrial design, engineering, sourcing, and manufacturing teams across international locations.

Collaborate with RENPHO’s Hong Kong and Shenzhen teams to translate product concepts into practical development plans.

Facilitate communication between global market-facing teams and technical development teams.

Participate in product workshops, design reviews, prototype evaluations, and supplier discussions.

Ensure clear handoffs from concept development to downstream product development and commercialization teams.

6. Product Performance & Continuous Innovation

Monitor product launches, consumer feedback, competitive developments, and market performance to identify future innovation opportunities.

Recommend product enhancements, line extensions, and next-generation concepts based on market insights.

Contribute to building a sustainable innovation pipeline that strengthens RENPHO’s global competitiveness.

Qualifications & Requirements:

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Product Management, Business, Engineering, Industrial Design, Marketing, or a related field.
3–5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, new product development, or a related function.
Experience in consumer electronics, smart wellness devices, fitness technology, connected health, smart home hardware, or related consumer technology categories.
Demonstrated experience developing new product concepts, conducting market research, or identifying product innovation opportunities.
Experience working with international consumer brands or products serving global markets.
Ability to translate consumer insights and market research into actionable product concepts and business recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and cross-functional communication skills.
Understanding of hardware product development processes, including product specifications, prototyping, feasibility assessment, and manufacturing considerations.
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.
Professional fluency in English.
Willingness and ability to travel frequently to Hong Kong and Shenzhen, China, and openness to relocation based on business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working with globally recognized consumer electronics or wellness technology brands.
Experience collaborating directly with OEM/ODM manufacturers, industrial designers, or hardware engineering teams.
Familiarity with smart sensors, connected devices, IoT ecosystems, fitness recovery technology, or health monitoring products.
Experience developing products for North American, European, or Asia-Pacific markets.
Understanding of international product safety, compliance, and regulatory considerations.
Experience conducting consumer research, product validation, competitive benchmarking, or early-stage commercial feasibility studies.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for more than a traditional Product Manager.

We want an innovation explorer — someone who constantly asks what consumers will need next, recognizes opportunities others may overlook, and has the initiative to turn promising ideas into real product possibilities.

You may be a strong fit if you:

Are naturally curious about emerging technologies and global consumer trends.
Enjoy discovering unmet needs and creating products from the ground up.
Combine creative thinking with analytical and commercial judgment.
Are comfortable experimenting, challenging assumptions, and navigating uncertainty.
Can collaborate effectively with both creative and technical teams.
Take ownership of ideas and actively drive them toward execution.
Are excited about shaping the next generation of consumer wellness technology.

Why Join RENPHO?

Shape the Future of Wellness: Help define new products that improve everyday health and wellness experiences.
Global Market Exposure: Work on product opportunities across major international consumer markets.
Innovation-Driven Environment: Explore emerging technologies and contribute directly to new product creation.
Cross-Border Collaboration: Partner with international commercial, engineering, and manufacturing teams.
Meaningful Product Ownership: Influence product direction from early-stage discovery through development readiness.

Equal Employment Opportunity

RENPHO is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics, in accordance with applicable employment laws.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit a resume highlighting relevant product management experience, international market exposure, and examples of new product concepts or innovations they have helped develop.

Join RENPHO and help create the next generation of smart wellness technology.
